machine.filesystem_backing: Unknown; overlay behavior and physical storage not independently verified.

limitations: Closed-loop, in-process tests on cached data and a virtualized overlay filesystem with unknown backing; no network, production server, cold storage, service wake-up, or project isolation is measured.

Prototype operations request sync_data before acknowledgement; SQLite is WAL, synchronous=FULL, and autocommit. Their full durability behavior has not been independently validated and SQLite implements SQL, transactions, and other features the prototype lacks.

Runs share a virtualized machine and have limited sample counts; p99.9 reflects very few samples per run and can vary widely. These are not a general performance, efficiency, reliability, or competitor ranking.

The large-write overlap cohort includes small writes that start during the large-write stream, even if they complete after it. Counts and stream durations vary between engines and runs; this is not a controlled offered-load or multi-tenant fairness test.
strace is used only for syscall counts and perturbs scheduling and elapsed time. Its counts include initialization and final value verification; timings are not compared.
